scope: All 53 catalog filenames known to this source import; presence in this inventory does not mean every file is required by every runtime mode.

status_definitions.direct: Included parser/projector reads explicit original data or an included earlier catalog; no unpublished evidence input.
status_definitions.direct-with-policy: Included projector also requires explicit local operator policy.
status_definitions.external-proof: Included projector requires separately qualified native/capture evidence; this repository does not create that evidence.
status_definitions.external-export: Included projector requires an external normalized export; upstream acquisition not included.
status_definitions.operator-configuration: User-authored policy/protocol configuration rather than extracted content.
status_definitions.gap: Complete regeneration tooling is not included; required external work is stated.

catalogs.command: project-retail-bootstrap.py --snapshot SNAPSHOT --catalog ITEMS --owner-attestation ATTESTATION --rules RULES --gear-slots SLOT_ENUM --faction-enum FACTION_ENUM --faction-identities IDENTITIES --faction-class 0:CharacterClassInfoA --faction-class 1:CharacterClassInfoB --faction-class 2:CharacterClassInfoC --output BOOTSTRAP
catalogs.inputs: Qualified native snapshot and owner attestation; authored item and rule catalogs; exact hash-qualified slot and faction enum texts; explicit numeric class mappings and external faction label/display/level identities. Replace A/B/C placeholders with actual numeric class suffixes.
catalogs.limitations: Projector and comparator included. Snapshot acquisition, enum extraction and native identity qualification are external. No faction display/map table is embedded. Generated equipment is not live acceptance proof.

catalogs.command: project-retail-combat.py --catalog ITEMS --bindings BINDINGS --bootstrap BOOTSTRAP --bullet-witness BULLET_PROOF --melee-witness MELEE_PROOF --selection SELECTION --runtime-policy POLICY --output COMBAT
catalogs.inputs: Authored retail item catalog; exact hash-qualified binding report, bootstrap and bullet witness; independently qualified external melee witness; explicit equipment-name selection with melee witness digest; explicit supported server runtime policy
catalogs.limitations: Actual projection included, not native evidence acquisition. Retained evidence hashes intentionally reject regenerated/changed artifacts until independently requalified. Selection is operator input requiring native qualification, not new proof; policy has no embedded grace default. Native physics/collision and live acceptance remain unproved.
